ui.noHints: No hints left in this room.
ui.emptyClues: No clues yet. Look around the room.
ui.needItem: You need to hold an item. Open the Casebook, tap Items, then tap Hold.
ui.wrongItem: That is not the right item for this.
ui.practiceHint: Trace the dotted shape, roughly is fine.
ui.inspectHint: Tap the object to turn it.

start.heading: The Realms Are Falling Out of Balance
paras: Four floating realms are kept in balance by a magic bridge called the Spirit Nexus.
A hundred years ago, the Nexus was sealed. Now Regent Ashkar steals the realms' Chi to power a war machine.
You are Tavi, a young monk who just woke up. With your friend Maren, relearn the four Forms and open the Nexus. You have 12 minutes.

tutorial.text: Drag on the screen to look around the room.
Tap objects to pick them up or look closer.
The Casebook keeps your clues, Forms, Marks and items. Puzzles do not show clues, so open it to read them.
Forms are shapes you draw: a tornado, a wave, a flame and a mountain. When a puzzle asks, draw the shape on the screen.
Chi is your score. A hint costs 30 Chi. You get 2 hints in each room. A wrong answer costs 10 Chi. You have 12 minutes. The clock only stops while Tavi and Maren talk.

open.1.t: The wind-shell cracks. A boy sits up in a quiet stone hall.

open.2.t: Hello? Where is everybody? It is so quiet.

open.3.t: You slept for a hundred years. I am Maren. I came to wake you up.

open.4.t: Ashkar has sealed the Nexus. We must learn the four Forms to open it again.

open.5.t: Four Forms. I only remember one, from a dream. Let's go!

idle.t: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

r1.enter.1.t: This was my home. It is so quiet now.

r1.enter.2.t: Find the toys that were yours. Look at the walls and the table.

r1.find.plaques.t: Four riddles. Each riddle is about one toy.

r1.inspect.suntop.t: A tiny crown mark under the toy. Remember it.

r1.discuss.t: The four stands need four toys in the right order. Look for a ring of four pictures.

r1.wrong.1.t: Think about what each toy does. Not only how it looks.

r1.wrong.2.t: Open the Casebook. The plaque riddles say which toy to pick. The ring picture gives the order.

r1.wrong.3.t: Order: the toy that hums, the one you blow, the one that rolls, the one with a house on its back.

r1.right.1.t: They hum together! I remember them. They were all mine.

r1.right.2.t: Fire, Air, Water, Earth. The Cycle starts again with you.

r1.right.3.t: Then the first Form is mine again. Watch this!

r1.idle.t: There are eight toys, but the stands take only four.

r2.enter.1.t: Frostmere. My family's city. The moon rules everything here.

r2.enter.2.t: Why are the gates frozen shut?

r2.inspect.valve.t: Copper pipes in an ice city? Something is pulling power away.

r2.find.note.t: Four pipes lead to one engine. That is the Regent's work.

r2.discuss.t: Four gates and four moons. Each gate wants a sea level first.

r2.wrong.1.t: First check what sea level each gate wants. Then pick a moon.

r2.wrong.2.t: The tide wall in your Casebook shows the sea level for each moon. The gate notes say what each gate needs.

r2.wrong.3.t: Two gates want the highest sea: the whole moon, and no moon. Two want the lowest: the half that grows, and the half that shrinks.

r2.right.1.t: The water is rising. The gates are opening!

r2.right.2.t: The moon pulls the tide. Water Forms flow in the same way.

r2.right.3.t: Then the second Form is flowing back to me.

r2.idle.t: There are eight moons but only four gates. What level does each gate want?

r3.enter.1.t: A garden in the sky. I love it here!

r3.enter.2.t: The Jade Lotus keeps old secrets. Find out how their game works.

r3.find.letter.t: The Regent wants all four realms at the same time. That is his plan.

r3.inspect.teapot.t: A paper bird! It says the Owl knows about the engine.

r3.discuss.t: Four tiles in every row. Each one needs its own place.

r3.wrong.1.t: Each element can show up only once in every row and every column.

r3.wrong.2.t: Start with Earth. All the Earth tiles are already there. Then fill in what is missing in each row.

r3.wrong.3.t: Row three needs Air and Fire. The first column already has Fire, so Air goes in the first square of row three.

r3.right.1.t: The petals open! The board sinks into the stone.

r3.right.2.t: The door was a harmony lock. Only a patient mind can open it.

r3.right.3.t: Earth waits to be pushed, so I push. The third Form is mine!

r3.idle.t: Earth is the easy one. Its four tiles are already placed.

r4.enter.1.t: So many books! Moku, do not touch the owl.

r4.enter.2.t: Few visit. Fewer read. Which one are you?

r4.inspect.ledger.t: This is very old. The Regent's family name is in it.

r4.discuss.t: The key has two parts, so we need both parts.

r4.wrong.1.t: The key is split in two. Check the shelves and the owl's wings.

r4.wrong.2.t: Your Casebook has all the pairs now. Match the scroll one picture at a time.

r4.wrong.3.t: The first word has four letters and ends with K. The second word has three letters and starts with S.

r4.right.1.t: Dark Sun. When the sun hides, the engine's fire hides too.

r4.right.2.t: An eclipse! That is when we can stop the engine.

r4.right.3.t: Take my glass. It bends shadow where you point it.

r4.idle.t: Four pictures, then three. Two short words.

r5.enter.1.t: You walk into my house, little monk. Enjoy it while you can.

r5.enter.2.t: He knows we are here. Stay calm and keep going.

r5.inspect.brazier.t: This fire was lit for the people. That is not how the Regent uses it.

r5.find.map.t: All four pipes end in one place: the Eclipse Court.

r5.discuss.t: The mask is breathing fire. I think I have to breathe back.

r5.wrong.1.t: Watch the mask again. The short and long flashes both matter.

r5.wrong.2.t: Your Casebook says a short flash is a quick tap, and a long glow is a slow press.

r5.wrong.3.t: Tap when the flash is short. Hold when the glow is long. Keep the same beat.

r5.right.1.t: The fires roar! It felt like breathing in and out.

r5.right.2.t: Fire is breath, not anger. Keep that in your heart.

r5.right.3.t: The fourth Form is mine! And the Cycle closes. Earth leads back to Fire.

r5.idle.t: Use Watch again. It is free.

r6.enter.1.t: The sun is black. I have never seen that.

r6.enter.2.t: The Dark Sun. The Owl was right. Use her glass!

r6.inspect.sundial.t: The dark sun will not last. We have to be quick.

r6.find.blueprint.t: The engine is linked to a mirror in the Nexus. Remember that.

r6.discuss.t: A beam enters low on the left. We must bend it to the crystal.

r6.wrong.1.t: Follow the beam with your eyes, one mirror at a time.

r6.wrong.2.t: The rules card in your Casebook shows how each mirror turns the beam. The court plan shows where the mirrors stand.

r6.wrong.3.t: The beam goes right, climbs up, goes right again, drops down, then runs right into the crystal.

r6.right.1.t: The shadow floods the crystal. The engine's glow is dying!

r6.right.2.t: The guards' flames are gone. But the Regent will not stop.

r6.right.3.t: Then we go to the Nexus. The bridge is open now.

r6.idle.t: The beam goes right first. Which way should the first mirror turn it?

r7.enter.1.t: Four pillars and a big mirror. This is the Nexus.

r7.enter.2.t: The engine is linked to that mirror. Ashkar is watching us.

r7.enter.3.t: Four realms in one cup. Comet night is mine.

r7.discuss.t: Read your Casebook. The Marks and the tablet will help you here.

r7.A.wrong.1.t: Check the four Marks in your Casebook.

r7.A.wrong.2.t: The Marks make a ring. The tablet tells you where the ring starts.

r7.A.wrong.3.t: Ashkar is Ember, which is Fire. Start with Fire, then follow the Marks.

r7.B.wrong.t: Open the Forms tab. Each pillar needs the Form of its own element.

r7.C.wrong.1.t: Remember what the elders wrote on the wall.

r7.C.wrong.2.t: Taking Chi breaks the Cycle, even from the Regent.

r7.C.wrong.3.t: Balance is returned, never taken. Return it.

r7.right.t: The Cycle is whole again. Everything is flowing back!

r7.idle.t: The Marks make a ring. Which element does the tablet say starts it?

end.1.t: Why did you not take it? It was yours.

end.2.t: It never was. It belongs to everyone.

end.4.t: The wind-shell is quiet. The Nexus is open and the Cycle turns once more.

end.5.t: Moku chirps and curls up on Tavi's shoulder.

r1.find.mural.t: The elders wrote this. Read it twice.

r1.find.cycle.t: Four pictures in a ring. The arrows show an order.

r2.find.tide.t: The moon changes the sea. Keep this chart.

r2.find.gates.t: Each gate has its own rule.

r3.find.scroll.t: A simple rule: each tile once in every row and column.

r3.find.token.t: A white lotus! It looks like it fits a door.

r4.find.scroll.t: Strange pictures. We need a key to read them.

r4.find.spines.t: Half of the key. The owl may have the rest.

r4.find.wings.t: The other half of the key is on the owl feathers!

r5.find.relief.t: The dragon breathes in short and long puffs.

r5.find.note.t: The engine needs light. Shadow can stop it.

r6.find.plan.t: A map of the floor. Note where each mirror stands.

r6.find.rules.t: Now I know how the mirrors turn the beam.

r7.find.tablet.t: Start with the one who broke the Cycle.

r7.find.shard.t: What was taken can be given back.

r7.find.offer.t: He wants me to take it all. No way.

r7.inspect.hand.t: The first Wayfarer's toy. Just like yours, Tavi.

c.r1.plaques.title: Plaque rubbings
c.r1.plaques.text:
Fire: My toy hums when it turns and never walks.
Air: Mine is blown, not flown.
Water: Mine rolls wherever the water goes.
Earth: Mine carries its house on its back.

c.r1.cycle.title: Cycle rubbing
c.r1.cycle.text: Four pictures in a ring: sun, wind, wave, mountain. Arrows go around from the sun.

c.r1.suntop.title: Sun-top (secret)
c.r1.suntop.text: A tiny crown mark is scratched under the toy.

c.r2.tide.title: Tide wall rubbing
c.r2.tide.text:
Sea level for each moon:
Highest: new moon and full moon.
Lowest: first quarter and last quarter.
Middle: the four crescent and gibbous moons.

c.r2.gates.title: Gate inscriptions
c.r2.gates.text:
Gate A: highest sea, whole moon.
Gate B: highest sea, no moon.
Gate C: lowest sea, the lit half is growing.
Gate D: lowest sea, the lit half is shrinking.

c.r2.note.title: Copper pipe note
c.r2.note.text: Chi is drained along four copper pipes into one engine.

c.r2.valve.title: Copper valve (secret)
c.r2.valve.text: A crown mark is stamped on the valve.

c.r3.scroll.title: Harmony scroll
c.r3.scroll.text: Each element can appear only once in every row and every column.

c.r3.letter.title: Lotus letter
c.r3.letter.text: The Regent needs all four realms at once, on comet night.

c.r3.token.title: White lotus token
c.r3.token.text: Taken from a lantern. It fits a carved door. Find it in Items.

c.r3.teapot.title: Teapot (secret)
c.r3.teapot.text: A paper bird says: The Owl knows where the engine sleeps.

c.r4.scroll.title: Glyph scroll
c.r4.scroll.text: Seven glyphs in two groups: four, then three.

c.r4.spines.title: Shelf spine key
c.r4.spines.text:
Spiral = D
Three dots = A
Crescent = R
Arrow = K

c.r4.wings.title: Owl wing key
c.r4.wings.text:
Ring with a dot = S
Wavy line = U
Tower = N

c.r4.ledger.title: Visitor ledger (secret)
c.r4.ledger.text: A very old note: A. only asked about eclipses.

c.r5.relief.title: Breath relief rubbing
c.r5.relief.text: Short flashes are quick puffs. Long glows are slow holds.

c.r5.note.title: Engine note
c.r5.note.text: The engine feeds on light. It fails in shadow.

c.r5.map.title: War map
c.r5.map.text: Four copper pipes run from the four realms to one place: the Eclipse Court.

c.r5.brazier.title: Brazier base (secret)
c.r5.brazier.text: Lit for the people, never for the throne.

c.r6.plan.title: Court plan
c.r6.plan.text: The floor is a grid of 5 rows and 5 columns. Row 1 is at the top. The lens slot is at row 5, column 1. The mirrors stand at row 5 column 2, row 3 column 2, row 3 column 4, and row 5 column 4. The crystal is at row 5, column 5.

c.r6.rules.title: Mirror rules card
c.r6.rules.text:
Slash mirror ( / ): a beam going right turns up. Up turns right. Left turns down. Down turns left.
Back-slash mirror ( \ ): a beam going right turns down. Down turns right. Left turns up. Up turns left.

c.r6.blueprint.title: Engine blueprint
c.r6.blueprint.text: The engine's heart is linked to a mirror in the Spirit Nexus.

c.r6.sundial.title: Sundial (secret)
c.r6.sundial.text: The Dark Sun passes quickly. Do not waste it.

c.r7.tablet.title: Guardian's tablet
c.r7.tablet.text: Begin with the element of the one who broke the Cycle.

c.r7.shard.title: Mirror shard
c.r7.shard.text: The engine drinks through this mirror. What was taken can be returned.

c.r7.offer.title: The Regent's offer
c.r7.offer.text: Join me. Take the Chi of the four realms and rule them.

c.r7.hand.title: Guardian's hand (secret)
c.r7.hand.text: It holds a small sun-top. It was the first Wayfarer's toy.

gust.name: Gust
gust.how: Draw a tornado: a spiral that winds round at least one and a half times.

flow.name: Flow
flow.how: Draw a wave with two humps, left to right.

root.name: Root
root.how: Draw a mountain: one peak, like a tent.

spark.name: Spark
spark.how: Draw a flame: tall, with a pointed top.

token.title: White lotus token
token.text: Fits the carved door in the Lotus Garden.

owl_glass.title: Owl-glass
owl_glass.text: Bends shadow. Fits a lens slot.

eclipse_seal.title: Eclipse Seal
eclipse_seal.text: Opens the bridge to the Spirit Nexus.

r1.title: Relic Test
r1.text: Tap a toy, then tap a stand. Tap a toy on a stand to take it back.

r2.title: Moon-Tide Gates
r2.text: Tap a gate's moon to change it. Then release the tide.

r3.title: Lotus Tile Game
r3.text: Tap an empty square to change its tile. Locked tiles cannot change.

r4.title: Forbidden Glyphs
r4.text: Tap a slot, then tap a letter. The slots sit under the scroll's glyphs.

r5.title: Dragon Breath
r5.text: Watch the mask. Tap for a short flash. Press and hold for a long glow.

r6.title: Shadow Routing
r6.text: Tap a mirror to flip it between / and \. Then cast the shadow.

r7.title: The Nexus Mirror
stepTexts: Put the four elements in order, to prove the Cycle. Check the Casebook.
Each pillar wakes in turn. Draw the Form of its element. Check the Forms tab.
r7.question: What will you do with the Chi?

choices.text: Take the Chi and keep it safe.
Seal the Regent inside the mirror.
Return the Chi to the four realms.

rooms.name: Windcrest Sanctuary
rooms.objective: Find the toys' clues, then solve the Relic Test.
hints: Read each rubbing in the Casebook. Match each riddle to one toy.
The ring goes sun, wind, wave, mountain. Put the matching toys in that order.

rooms.name: Frostmere Citadel
rooms.objective: Learn the tide levels, then open the four gates.
hints: Match each gate's sea level to the tide wall chart.
The sea is highest at the full and new moon. It is lowest at the two quarters. The growing half is the first quarter.

rooms.name: Jade Lotus Garden
rooms.objective: Solve the lotus board, then open the boulder door.
hints: Read the Harmony scroll. All four Earth tiles are already fixed.
Row three is missing Air and Fire. The first column already has Fire.

rooms.name: Owlwind Archive
rooms.objective: Find both halves of the key, then read the scroll.
hints: Find both halves of the key: on the shelf spines and on the owl's wings.
The two words have four letters and three letters. The second is what an eclipse hides.

rooms.name: Ember Citadel
rooms.objective: Learn how the dragon breathes, then breathe back.
hints: Use Watch again. It is free. Count the flashes.
A short flash is a tap. A long glow is a press and hold.

rooms.name: Eclipse Court
rooms.objective: Use the Owl-glass, then bend the beam to the crystal.
hints: Trace the beam from the lens. The first mirror must send it up, not down.
From the first to the last, the mirrors are slash, slash, back-slash, back-slash.

rooms.name: Spirit Nexus
rooms.objective: Read the clues, then use the pillars and the mirror.
hints: Read the four Marks and the tablet in the Casebook.
Begin with Fire. Then Air, Water, Earth. Each pillar wants the Form of its own element.

end.winText: The Cycle turns again. The four realms are safe.
end.loseText: The comet crosses the sky. The Regent drinks the four realms. Try again, and be faster.
end.sequel: A pale figure whispers: "He was only the first to drink."
